snippet.title: UN:Me - Quality Upgrade Movie
snippet.description:
Crafting a Better Experience — Launching 2027

■Wishlist Now
・PlayStation™ Store：https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019807
・Steam®：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4167200/

■What is UN:Me?
UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

・Platform: Nintendo Switch 2 / PlayStation 5 / Steam 
・Genre: Soul Triage Adventure
・Number of players: Single-player
・Rating: IARC12+
・Language: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
・Publisher: SHUEISHA GAMES
・Planning & Development: historia Inc.
・Planning & Scenario: Takuya Yamanaka

©SHUEISHA,SHUEISHA GAMES developed by historia
